title: Static Twin Wheel Chain Bucket Lift
description: One new whole static dry chain-bucket irrigation-lift appearance: two vertically separated open-rim wheels on full axles and a grounded braced timber frame carry two continuous closed capsule-shaped chain-route bands and a fixed row of ten whole thick open buckets. The ascending buckets face upward, return-side buckets downward and the two turning buckets sideways. A separate elevated sloping U-section outlet gutter on its full support stands beside the upper route. This is not the previous single paddle waterwheel, single-rope well, piston/treadle pump or an extra row of buckets on an old model. All visible geometry new, three opaque PBR roles, metres and whole XY-centred ground origin. Stylized continuous bands indicate chain routing; individual articulated chain links, sprocket engagement, empty-cycle trajectories, liquid pickup/discharge, drive input, motion, pressure/lift/flow efficiency, bearings, load/stability/manufacture and safety are not modeled or certified. Dry visual game prop, not operating instructions.
